meta.recheck_note: v3.3: re-signed to the current artifact bytes (2026-11-07T18:05:22, 186,343 B). canonical_digest recomputed independently = aefdf528... and agrees with the artifact field. Added out_of_table_differences (note on 14 companions: known, not a violation), count_definitions for 67/65/73, and resign_basis recording what I could and could not verify about the digest change.
meta.revision_note_v3_4: v3.3 signed a specific byte instance (18:05:22 / b661c8cd...). At 19:23:57 the implementation regenerated the artifact: size unchanged at 186,343 B, full sha256 moved to df5e1a63... because generated_at changed, and canonical_digest stayed aefdf528... with 218 records unchanged. Under contract 7.12.4 the signing object is the triple (canonical_digest + schema_version + scanned_sources), not the file bytes, and the sidecar .sha256 is explicitly demoted to "this run was byte-complete". v3.4 therefore stops asserting a byte hash and records byte instances as observations only, so a rerun that touches only generated_at cannot invalidate the signature.

rules_applied.N1: field:X form: check base-column set ALLOWED_FIELDS (measured 54) first -> namespace=column; only on miss fall back to registry -> namespace=factor; registry kind=virtual -> namespace=virtual.
rules_applied.N2: When one name is both a base column and a kind=custom pack factor id (measured exactly 4: ma20 / ma60 / boll_lower / boll_upper) the two paths disagree, so that occurrence must also emit a companion record.
rules_applied.N3: Only timeframe=intraday objects enter the intraday frame; custom_signals.py:646-647 continues past non-intraday, so the 21 daily sources are unreachable on the intraday path.
rules_applied.N4: path_scope records the real evaluation path only -> 21 history, 1 monitor_rule intraday; both count 0; path_divergence all false (v0.6 7.10.3 fixed this as a code fact, not an inference).
rules_applied.granularity: Per occurrence: each left / right / conditions[].field is one record; a pure numeric right-hand literal is not counted (e.g. limit_down_recovery.json:11 right=0).
rules_applied.verdict_rule: primary -> allow (nothing is blocked by FS01); companion -> exempt (recorded, not blocking). Source verdict = worst primary verdict of that source (block > shadow > allow) -> all 22 sources allow.
rules_applied.both_collision_rule: primary is always false, companion always true, distinguished by record_kind (7.10.2 line 1066 / 7.12.2). Collision visibility comes from pairing the (source_path, evidence, side, ref_name) tuple with its companion, not from a boolean on the primary.
rules_applied.literal_fields: ref_raw keeps the field:/column:/signal: prefix; ref_name strips it and trims; side is L/R/F only; structural keys (conditions[i].left etc.) go to side_key only; source_path is relative to data_root without the user_data/ prefix, path_base=data.

signature_triple.byte_sha_policy: Never a signing target (contract 7.12.4: the sidecar .sha256 only proves this run was byte-complete; the sign-off is the triple). A rerun that changes only generated_at/repo_head/data_root keeps canonical_digest identical by construction, so the signature survives it. Only a change in records or in the five literal fields (and anything else 7.12.4 does not strip) can invalidate the signature; any such change must be re-signed.

count_definitions.scanned_sources = 67: Sum of the six scan functions' scanned-file counts: custom_signal 21 + monitor_rule 1 + strategy_override 2 + custom_factor 15 + strategy_config 25 + research_strategy 1. Counts files a scanner OPENED, including files that emit no record.
count_definitions.unique source_path = 65: Distinct source_path across all 218 records. Equals 67 minus 2 strategy_override files that are scanned but emit zero references because both have scoring={} and overlay_filter=[]: strategy_overrides/custom_khunter_limit_up_pullback.json; strategy_overrides/first_limit_pullback_3f_runner_t74.json
count_definitions.all_records.sources = 73: Distinct (source_path, source_id) pairs. Equals 65 + 8 because one research_strategy file (research/strategy-search-20261107/factor_map_v1.json) carries 9 strategy ids (S01..S11), contributing 9 pairs from 1 file.
count_definitions.why_they_differ: Three different units: files opened / files that yielded records / (file,id) pairs. 67-65=2 is the two zero-reference override files; 73-65=8 is the multi-id research file. Neither difference is the other.
count_definitions.correction_to_a_verbal_account: A verbal account said the 67/65 gap comes from the research file. It does not: the scan functions do count that file as 1 and count strategy_override as 2 files on disk, while only 2 of them yield records. The 8 difference belongs to 73-65, not to 67-65.
